items.title: Edwards Lifesciences (EW) Stock Looks Reasonable After Medicare TAVR Expansion
items.summary: Edwards Lifesciences has delivered a mixed share price story, with the stock up 18.4% over the past year but still down sharply over a 5 year span. This puts the focus squarely on what investors are paying for its future cash flows. With fresh policy news around its core heart valve franchise and a current share price of US$88.25, the key issue is whether the company’s cash generation can support where the stock trades today. items.title: CMS expands TAVR Medicare coverage to asymptomatic patients
items.summary: The Centers for Medicare and Medicaid Services’ policy update extends Medicare coverage to severe aortic stenosis patients without symptoms, a change that analysts said will especially benefit Edwards Lifesciences.
